user.title: ebusd Vaillant
user.description: Configure the ebusd MQTT integration. Make sure the MQTT integration is set up first.

data_description.name: Name shown in entity labels, e.g. "Vaillant" produces "Vaillant Zone 1"
data_description.mqtt_prefix: The root topic ebusd publishes to (default: ebusd)

error.mqtt_not_available: The MQTT integration is not available. Please set it up first.

abort.already_configured: This ebusd prefix is already configured.

data.zones_with_temp_only: Only zones with a temperature reading

data_description.away_mode_duration: Number of days the away mode lasts when activated (default: 7)
data_description.quick_veto_duration: Number of hours the quick veto lasts when triggered (default: 3)
data_description.max_zones: Maximum number of heating zones to discover (1-4, default: 4)
data_description.prime_poll_values: Publish ?1 to /get topics on startup so ebusd polls all values at priority 1 immediately
data_description.zones_with_temp_only: When enabled (default), only create climate entities for zones that report a current temperature. When disabled, create entities for all zones up to the configured maximum.
data_description.cooling: Whether zones offer cooling (heat/cool target range and the cool mode). Auto decides from what the system reports, e.g. Hc1CoolingEnabled or the cooling yield. Without cooling each zone has one target temperature.
data_description.temperature_write: What changing a zone's target temperature writes. Smart: the permanent setpoint in Manual mode, a temporary boost (quick veto) in Time controlled mode. Always quick veto: the behaviour before 1.1.0.

options.smart: Smart (Manual: setpoint, Time controlled: quick veto)
